title: Taking over the band department and the players who stayed
summary: With the bandmaster gone he ran the band programs, and when he left for New York the players said they would stay with him if he got jobs.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Now, what else were you doing besides arranging, beginning to compose in that sense, and to sort of, began to take more charge or command of the band?

Well, during the last 2 years, the band, the bandmaster there, the teacher, he left to go to Atlanta to one of the schools there. So, the president, actually turned his department over to me. Then, they had the symptom to cover the band. Besides the 'Bama State
Collegians and the 'Bama State Pevellers, they had the field band. So, in other words, I was over that department. Then, that's how I happened to be, was run into the leadership.

So, when I left, I didn't finish that, you know, cause I went from there on into New York. That's how I happened to get in front of the band there. The boys were supposed to they turned around they were supposed to come back to school. But, they decided, they said Hawk, if you can get the jobs, we'll stick with you. So, they stayed with me.
So, all of the fellows that were in the band when you went out, they didn't go back to school?
